description: Theme-relevant key events and crowding (event-scenario-mapping, design docs/design/scenario_set_and_ablation_design.md §5.1/§5.3, step 9). Per scenario: which 8-K items count toward its news multiplier (each with its own item weight, decayed as in news.json), whether GDELT tone counts, whether crowding applies (only for names whose short-interest history passes the reliability check), and which items on which names mark it live. News and crowding scale every single-name equity driver of the scenario that is not an XbrlRag leg on its company-specific part only; tickers in 'excluded' and the scenario's severity lead are never scaled. Scenarios without a theme get no news, no crowding and no triggers. Composition rule dualrag-v3.
_item_weights: Must equal item_allowlist in configs/marketdata/news/news_marketdata.json (a unit test checks).

ai_deflation._why: Results and guidance (capex), Reg FD updates and impairments; hyperscaler results make it live.

taiwan_geopolitical._why: Export-control and supply-chain disclosures; the GPR index is its live trigger.

crowded_unwind._why: Positioning sets the cross-section; earnings 8-Ks are single-name amplifiers.

ai_capex_credit._why: Debt issuance (2.03) and material agreements (1.01, e.g. data-center leases) by the AI-capex issuers.

_themes: inflation_repricing and rate_capital have no theme. Item 2.03 triggers AI-capex credit (#8, step 11b).
